trans-unit.resname: Gmail, Yahoo and Outlook demand that commercial email carries a List-Unsubscribe header and, since 2024, a List-Unsubscribe-Post header so their "Unsubscribe" button works without the reader leaving the mailbox (RFC 8058). Without it your messages lose reputation and end up in the spam folder.
trans-unit.source: Gmail, Yahoo and Outlook demand that commercial email carries a List-Unsubscribe header and, since 2024, a List-Unsubscribe-Post header so their "Unsubscribe" button works without the reader leaving the mailbox (RFC 8058). Without it your messages lose reputation and end up in the spam folder.
trans-unit.target: Gmail, Yahoo y Outlook exigen que el correo comercial lleve una cabecera List-Unsubscribe y, desde 2024, una cabecera List-Unsubscribe-Post para que su botón «Darse de baja» funcione sin que el lector salga del buzón (RFC 8058). Sin eso, tus mensajes pierden reputación y acaban en la carpeta de correo no deseado.

trans-unit.resname: HTTPS is mandatory. Over plain HTTP the module still adds List-Unsubscribe, but not the one-click part, because the mailboxes reject it.

trans-unit.target: El HTTPS es obligatorio. Por HTTP el módulo sigue añadiendo List-Unsubscribe, pero no la parte de un clic, porque los buzones la rechazan.
